scope: Deterministic offline evaluation framework, not another model search or GP fit batch

metric_hierarchy.parsimony: Input count breaks economically indistinguishable ties; no automatic threshold is invented

required_covariance: Complete predictive observed-return covariance, raw target units, including likelihood noise; task-kernel B and marginal variances alone are insufficient
precision_policy: Exact analytic and Gaussian plug-in scenario covariance scores are labeled separately; no covariance independence assumption, repair or silent fallback
fixed_probe_policy: Same deterministic weights across models and seeds, never chosen based on realized returns
risk_calibration: Errors about ex-ante predicted means: mean z, mean z squared, error RMS to predicted SD RMS, PIT bins, 50/80/95 coverage and widths
return_units: Decimal discounted-excess targets for forecast scores; explicit frozen-RF conversion for arithmetic-excess Sharpe and total-return NAV
cost_policy: Primitive functions support explicit beginning-wealth costs. CLI cached study is gross because no cost series is supplied
evaluation_status: Exploratory reused months, not untouched holdout
